name: @easyeda-copilot/router
description: EDA-neutral PCB polygon and autorouting orchestration

scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:legacy && node scripts/copy-router-assets.mjs && node scripts/copy-polygon-assets.mjs
scripts.build:public: tsup src/index.ts src/intent/index.ts src/core/index.ts src/schema.ts src/adapters/contracts.ts src/backends/easyeda-wasm.ts src/backends/krt.ts src/cli.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --out-dir package-dist --dts --clean --tsconfig tsconfig.public.json
scripts.build:legacy: tsup src/benchmark.ts src/render.ts src/poly-test.ts src/poly-validate.ts src/polygon/index.ts src/net-scheduler.ts src/filled-copper-proxy.ts src/ground-plane.ts src/power-intent.ts src/workflow-board.ts src/workflow-validation.ts src/completion-routing.ts src/staged-routing.ts src/portfolio-routing.ts src/backends/krt-adapter.ts src/backends/freerouting-adapter.ts src/backends/easyeda-wasm-adapter.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist
scripts.test: node scripts/run-all.mjs && node scripts/check-polygon-dsl.mjs && node scripts/check-staged-workflow.mjs && node scripts/check-power-intent.mjs && node scripts/check-ground-plane.mjs && node scripts/check-package-contract.mjs
